summary: A ~15 m pontoon houseboat: a stained-timber clapboard cabin with framed sash windows and a hinged front door… joints front_door, outboard; sockets waterline, front_door, roof_deck, helm.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.houseboat or place "prefab": "houseboat" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
